title: bug: list_metrics doneCount, the dashboard's totalCompleted and per-epic completed count only status DONE while avgWallClockMs includes ARCHIVED rows, so a Done-column Clear zeroes "completed" for delivered work and the aggregates disagree
description:
Held item from hunt #11 (task-afe61cc0, architect-74d9e1c7, msg-7ed73235), filed by the governor in BACKLOG. It edits util/metrics.ts, the same file as task-5d739855 (the sinceIso fix), so it waits on that row. The governor promotes it once 5d739855 is DONE.

PROBLEM. Archiving a delivered task (the IDE's Done-column Clear) drops it from every "completed" count, while the same row still feeds avgWallClockMs. Today 205 live ARCHIVED rows carry doneAt, and none of them counts as completed.

EVIDENCE (util/metrics.ts at 8ca8d389):
- :71 `if (task.status === 'DONE') { doneCount += 1; … }`.
- :186 per-epic `completed: agg.doneCount`, and :197 `totalCompleted: overall.doneCount`. avgWallClockMs is computed over rows that include ARCHIVED.
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-afe61cc0/B/zzHuntB_metricsArchived.test.ts with its .output.txt. "counts a delivered-then-archived task consistently across doneCount, firstPass% and avgWallClockMs" fails.

DECISION (governor reading; the planner may refine it with evidence). "Completed" means delivered: a row in DONE, or a row in ARCHIVED with metrics.doneAt (or another landed-delivery marker). An ARCHIVED row that never reached DONE (shelved) is not completed. Apply the same set to doneCount, firstPass%, per-epic completed, totalCompleted and avgWallClockMs, so the aggregates agree.
definitionOfDone: doneCount, firstPass%, per-epic completed, totalCompleted and avgWallClockMs all count the same delivered set: DONE rows plus ARCHIVED rows that reached DONE. A shelved ARCHIVED row that never reached DONE counts in none of them.

The ported hunt repro passes, and the existing metrics and list_metrics tests stay green in a snapshot outside the shared checkout. MCP_SERVER.md or SCHEMA.md wording on "completed" is updated only if the file is free per lanes.js.

implementationPlan.description:
The fix goes in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/metrics.ts only. Use your Edit tool.

(a) In `interface MetricsAggregate`, put `/** Delivered rows: DONE, or ARCHIVED after reaching DONE (see isDelivered). */` on the line above `doneCount: number;`.

(b) Directly above the `/**` that opens computeMetricsAggregate's doc comment (`Compute aggregate metrics across the given tasks...`), add:
```ts
/**
 * Completed, for every aggregate here (doneCount, firstPassApprovalPct,
 * avgWallClockMs, and the dashboard's totalCompleted and per-epic completed):
 * a DONE row, or an ARCHIVED row that reached DONE. qa_approve stamps
 * metrics.doneAt, the startup backfill fills it on a DONE row without one,
 * util/reopen.ts strips it on reopen and archiving keeps it, so on an ARCHIVED
 * row it marks delivered work. A shelved ARCHIVED row never had one.
 */
function isDelivered(task: Task): boolean {
  if (task.status === 'DONE') return true;
  const doneAt = task.metrics?.doneAt;
  return task.status === 'ARCHIVED' && typeof doneAt === 'string' && doneAt.trim() !== '';
}
```

(c) In computeMetricsAggregate's loop:
- Change `if (task.status === 'DONE') {` to `if (isDelivered(task)) {`.
- Move the `if (typeof m.wallClockMs === 'number' && Number.isFinite(m.wallClockMs)) { ... }` block INSIDE that branch, after the two firstPass lines.
- Put these two comment lines right before it: `// Wall-clock averages the same delivered rows, so a stale value on a` and `// shelved or in-flight row never leaks into it.`

Nothing else changes:
- taskCount, avgReopenCount, totalRejectCount, totalExecutedStepCount and totalToolCalls still sum every filtered row.
- filterTasksForMetrics (5d739855's sinceIso key), toPerTaskMetric, computeDashboardAggregate and tools/listMetrics.ts stay byte-identical.
- The dashboard follows through computeMetricsAggregate: totalCompleted = overall.doneCount, per-epic completed = agg.doneCount, and firstPassApprovalPct is omitted while doneCount is 0.
- Field names and reply shapes are unchanged (epic rail: no MCP contract break).

Error handling: this is a pure function over in-memory rows, so no new error handling is needed. A row without metrics reads `{}`. A missing, non-string or blank doneAt is simply not delivered: it is never parsed, so it cannot throw. No I/O and no new throw path are added.

Check: run the GREEN gate (first checkRef). In the architect's /tmp dry run of this exact edit, tsc was clean and 4 files / 61 tests passed.

Docs, only if the file is free (DoD 2).

Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` and check whether any open row other than 83cf11f5 lists docs/MCP_SERVER.md. When this was planned, b7203d89 and a024ac57 did, both in REVIEW.

If one does, make no edit. Complete this step with no modifiedFiles, and post one #general line: `task-83cf11f5: MCP_SERVER.md list_metrics/GET_METRICS completed wording left for a follow-up: held by <ids>`.

If it is free, use your Edit tool to make exactly these six edits and nothing else. Each old line is unique in the file.
(1) list_metrics Returns. Old: `    firstPassApprovalPct,           // 0..100; first-pass = DONE with rejectCount===0`. New: `    firstPassApprovalPct,           // 0..100; first-pass = delivered (see Notes) with rejectCount===0`.
(2) list_metrics Notes. Insert a new bullet directly after the bullet that starts `- Per-task entries are sorted newest-first by`:
`- **Delivered** is the completed set: a `DONE` row, or an `ARCHIVED` row that reached DONE (it keeps the `metrics.doneAt` that `moe.qa_approve` stamped; a reopen strips it). `doneCount`, `firstPassApprovalPct` and `avgWallClockMs` count only delivered rows, and so do `GET_METRICS`' `totalCompleted`, per-epic `completed` and `avgWallClockMs`. A shelved `ARCHIVED` row that never reached DONE, and every in-flight row, count only in `taskCount`, `avgReopenCount` and the totals.`
(3) GET_METRICS. Old: `    firstPassApprovalPct?: number,     // omitted when no DONE tasks`. New: `    firstPassApprovalPct?: number,     // omitted when no delivered tasks (list_metrics Notes)`.
(4) Old: `    avgWallClockMs?: number,           // omitted when no completed tasks have wall-clock data`. New: `    avgWallClockMs?: number,           // omitted when no delivered tasks have wall-clock data`.
(5) Old: `    totalCompleted?: number,`. New: `    totalCompleted?: number,           // delivered tasks (list_metrics doneCount)`.
(6) Old: `      completed: number,`. New: `      completed: number,               // delivered tasks in this epic`.

docs/SCHEMA.md needs no change: its TaskMetrics block defines doneAt and wallClockMs only, and has no completed wording.

Verification, run once.

Run the GREEN gate (first checkRef) verbatim. It is complete_task's verification and takes about 2 min, because it runs npm ci in a fresh /tmp snapshot. Never run npm or vitest in the checkout (rail). Expect `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, then `Test Files  4 passed (4)` and `Tests  61 passed (61)`. The count moves only if a peer adds tests to those files.

Then run the RED gate (second checkRef) once more. It must still print RED-AT-BASE, because it pins ab9b5237's metrics.ts. Quote its output in your completion summary.

Error handling for a red run:
- If a governanceFeatures or defensiveBatch test fails, re-run it in a second snapshot with HEAD's metrics.ts overlaid.
- If it fails there too, it is pre-existing. Do not edit those files: report it in #general and call moe.report_blocked with the evidence.
- If it fails only with your change, fix metrics.ts. Never weaken a test.

Leave nothing inside the checkout. The snapshots live in /tmp.

Its only prerequisite, 5d739855 (list_metrics sinceIso key), reached DONE at 22:05:50Z (QA_APPROVED, completion ab9b5237), so plan against the landed util/metrics.ts at the tip. The governor's reading of the definition from filing time still applies: "completed" = DONE plus ARCHIVED rows that reached DONE. The human can drag this row back to BACKLOG to veto.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: util/metrics.ts counts one delivered set for every completed aggregate: a DONE row, or an ARCHIVED row that reached DONE, meaning an ARCHIVED row with a non-blank string metrics.doneAt. That set is used by list_metrics' doneCount, firstPassApprovalPct (denominator and numerator) and avgWallClockMs, and by GET_METRICS' totalCompleted, firstPassApprovalPct, avgWallClockMs, per-epic completed and per-epic avgWallClockMs. A shelved ARCHIVED row and an in-flight row count in none of them, even with a stale wallClockMs. taskCount, avgReopenCount and the totals still cover every filtered row.
acceptanceCriteria: DoD 1: (d1)-(d4) and (p1)-(p2) pass. Take a DONE row (wall 1000, rejectCount 0), an ARCHIVED row with doneAt (wall 9000, rejectCount 1), a shelved ARCHIVED row and a WORKING row, the last two both with a stale wallClockMs. For that set, computeMetricsAggregate gives taskCount 4, doneCount 2, firstPassApprovalPct 50 and avgWallClockMs 5000. The dashboard gives totalCompleted 2, per-epic completed 2 and 0, and per-epic avgWallClockMs 5000 and undefined.

DoD 2: the ported hunt repro (p1) passes, and metrics.test.ts, governanceFeatures.test.ts and defensiveBatch.test.ts stay green in a /tmp snapshot (GREEN checkRef). Against ab9b5237's metrics.ts the new tests give exactly 5 failed | 12 passed (17) (RED checkRef). MCP_SERVER.md is edited only if lanes.js shows it free. SCHEMA.md needs no change.
invariants: Field names, types and units of list_metrics.aggregate and GET_METRICS are unchanged. firstPassApprovalPct stays an integer 0..100, and optional dashboard fields stay undefined when empty.
filterTasksForMetrics (5d739855's sinceIso key), toPerTaskMetric, and the per-task list and its sort are unchanged.
A DONE row counts whatever its metrics hold. An ARCHIVED row counts only with a non-blank string metrics.doneAt.
compatibility: Legacy rows load unchanged: there is no migration and no write. Pre-metrics ARCHIVED rows (empty metrics) stay out of completed, as before.
approvedScope: util/metrics.ts: the MetricsAggregate.doneCount JSDoc, a module-local isDelivered(task), and the computeMetricsAggregate loop.
Tests: an appended describe block in metrics.test.ts and a new tools/listMetrics.delivered.test.ts.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md: the list_metrics and GET_METRICS comment lines plus one Notes bullet, only if lanes.js shows the file free.
reuse: computeDashboardAggregate keeps deriving totalCompleted and per-epic completed from computeMetricsAggregate, so one predicate covers both endpoints.
Existing test scaffolding: the metrics.test.ts fixtures, and ToolTestHarness for the port.
sourceAssumptions: util/metrics.ts:71-81 (ab9b5237): doneCount and approvalCount key on status === 'DONE', while the wallClockMs sum runs over every row.

metrics.doneAt is written only by tools/qaApprove.ts:194 and by state/backfills/backfillTaskMetrics.ts:110 (DONE rows only). util/reopen.ts:61-63 strips it. archiveTask.ts and WebSocketServer ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS (:907-917), the Done-column Clear, keep it.

Live board on 2026-11-04: all 573 DONE rows carry doneAt and wallClockMs, and 205 ARCHIVED rows carry doneAt (all of them with wallClockMs). 165 ARCHIVED rows carry neither: shelved rows, plus 6 pre-metrics 2026-02-08 rows whose reviewCompletedAt qa_reject also writes.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Mark ARCHIVED rows as delivered by reviewCompletedAt or landing.lastCompletion. Rejected: qa_reject also stamps reviewCompletedAt, and a completion can land and then be rejected. (2) Stamp doneAt at archive time, or on every move to DONE in the store. Rejected as scope: it changes write paths for a gap with no live instance (all 573 DONE rows carry doneAt). (3) Keep avgWallClockMs over every row that has a wallClockMs. Rejected: the DoD wants one set, and since reopen strips wallClockMs the change only moves stale or hand-made data. (4) Export isDelivered. Not needed: the aggregates exercise it.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Both endpoints share computeMetricsAggregate. list_metrics (tools/listMetrics.ts) calls it directly. GET_METRICS (WebSocketServer.ts:985-996) reaches it through computeDashboardAggregate. So one predicate in the loop fixes doneCount, firstPassApprovalPct, avgWallClockMs, totalCompleted, and per-epic completed and avgWallClockMs together.

tsconfig excludes *.test.ts, so tsc checks only the source, and vitest does not type-check.

The architect's /tmp dry run of exactly this plan's code:
- RED: 5 failed | 12 passed (17), failing (d1)-(d4) and (p1).
- GREEN: tsc clean, 61/61 tests over 4 files in about 2 s.
- Four mutants killed: any-ARCHIVED, truthy doneAt, untrimmed doneAt, and DONE-only.
planningNotes.risks:
When planned, docs/MCP_SERVER.md was held by b7203d89 and a024ac57 (both in REVIEW). Step 3 therefore depends on lanes.js at run time, per the DoD.

Residual, by design:
- A row moved to DONE without qa_approve may carry no doneAt, so once archived it leaves completed.
- The 6 pre-metrics ARCHIVED rows stay out.
Neither case has a reliable marker today.
